purpose: Fresh bounded qualification of Kigali, Porto-Novo and Victoria; successful neighbourhood checks do not override a held WUP-centre result. No sources were admitted.

Victoria.note: No Seychelles Victoria row was present in the WUP 2025 bulk city source; capital identity remains explicit.

learnings: Coordinate qualification now requires a ninth alignment gate: establish native/storage CRS separately from service output and metric CRS; preserve first-party metadata, explicit wire axes/units, unchanged native ID+geometry and hashes, then independently verify the documented transform with required grids.

Follow world-parcels/research/parcel-alignment-2026-10-14/index.json. Never fit offsets, rotations or scale to OSM/imagery, guess a datum/epoch, or change measured geometry. Source errors and ambiguous/unavailable coordinate operations remain held.
ArcGIS native field names are case-sensitive: this Kigali service returns objectid and upi; use esri-json because the GeoJSON route was rejected.

A clean neighbourhood subset does not prove geometry quality at the exact WUP centre: Kigali passed on 72 features nearby but the WUP-centre run held on one material overlap among 82 unchanged features.
Porto-Novo protocol and paging checks passed but 264 unchanged features include one invalid polygon and nine material overlaps; no corrected-source selection semantics were established.

Victoria exact IDs and a small geometry audit passed, while provider gateway errors and the adapter 15-second timeout prevented the 13-cell completeness checks. Do not infer absent cadastral coverage from these failures.
Geometry is never repaired, clipped, simplified or filtered merely to pass qualification. Preserve exact provenance and hold until the missing gate is proven.
